research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Genecis is engaged in developing recombinant bacterial host cells that metabolize and convert glycerol or volatile fatty acids to poly(3-hydroxybutyrate-co-3-hydroxyvalerate) (PHBV), as described in the work titled 'Recombinant bacterial cells and methods for producing poly(3-hydroxybutyrate-co...'. Their research focuses on methods for producing PHBV using engineered bacteria, highlighting efforts in biotechnological conversion of organic substrates into high-value biopolymers.

product_launches.description: Genecis Bioindustries launched Mad Coffee, a new consumer brand offering instant, premium iced coffee using proprietary LyoExtract technology in compostable cups. The product is available online and in over 400 Sprouts Farmers Market stores nationwide.

overview_description.description: Genecis is an early-stage organic waste processing startup that uses biotechnology to convert waste into biodegradable plastics and other high-value materials. It converts organic waste into PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoate), a biodegradable, compostable, and non-toxic polymer that can be tuned to replace a wide variety of traditional plastics. PHA can be used for single-use plastics, clothing and textiles, automotive interiors, medical tools and products, and food contact applications.

product.name: PHA Plastics
product.description: Genecis produces PHA plastics from organic waste, offering a biodegradable alternative to traditional plastics for use in packaging, textiles, automotive parts, and medical equipment.

product.name: Custom PHA Polymer Formulation
product.description: Genecis offers custom PHA polymer formulation services, tailoring the biodegradability, functionality, and quality of PHA plastics to meet specific partner product requirements.

product.name: PHA-based Product Development
product.description: The company collaborates with partners to develop new products made from PHA, ensuring these meet sustainability goals and are ready for commercialization.
